description: Header file defining the ApplicationX11 class, which manages X11 windowing, event handling, and integration with the starboard application framework for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment.

classes.name: ApplicationX11
classes.description: Manages X11 window creation, event processing, and integration with the starboard application framework, including video frame handling and input device management.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates a new X11 window with specified options.

methods.name: Composite
methods.description: Makes the current GL and video layers visible.

methods.name: SwapBuffersBegin
methods.description: Prepares for updating the GL layer.

methods.name: SwapBuffersEnd
methods.description: Finalizes updates to the GL layer.

methods.name: PlayerSetBounds
methods.description: Sets the display bounds for a video player.

methods.name: AcceptFrame
methods.description: Handles a new video frame for a player.

methods.name: IsStartImmediate
methods.description: Determines if start should be immediate based on preload switch.

methods.name: IsPreloadImmediate
methods.description: Determines if preload should be immediate based on preload switch.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Checks if system events are pending.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event with a timeout.

methods.name: GetPendingEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next pending X11 event.

methods.name: XEventToEvent
methods.description: Converts an XEvent to an internal Event object.

methods.name: FindWindow
methods.description: Finds the SbWindow associated with an X11 Window.
